title: 把顺序聊清楚
description: 两位成人在垫区外交流路线，一人轻示手点，另一人看脚点。

art_direction.medium: crisp digital comic ink and quiet halftone shadows
art_direction.scene: Two fictional adults discuss an easy low-wall sequence from outside the landing area. One gestures with an open hand toward a nearby generous handhold while the other looks at the broad foothold directly below it. Their expressions are engaged and unhurried, with ordinary gym clothing and no devices in hand. Compose the conversation and short route together in a wide scene, keeping the mats empty and the obvious descent line visible. Use a soft graphite-and-watercolor illustration with precise posture contours, luminous color washes, and cool blue balanced by warm ochre. Create one original 1536x1024 wordless scene, fictional fully clothed adults, natural anatomy; no brands, arrows or panels. Climbing stays low above continuous thick mats, with immediate step-down.
